## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Stops an instance of damage over time started by the [Start Damage Over Time](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/start%2Bdamage%2Bover%2Btime) action.

## Snippet

```
Stop Damage Over Time(Last Damage Over Time ID);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Damage Over Time ID_==

> ==**Damage Over Time ID**==
> _Type: **Damage Over Time ID**, Default: **[Last Damage Over Time ID](/wiki/articles/last+damage+over+time+id)**_
> Specifies which damage over time instance to stop. This id may be last damage over time id or a variable into which last damage over time id was earlier stored.
````
